QuestInfo.name: A Black Shadow in the Pig Farm
QuestInfo.0: I'll need to talk to Agent #b#p1103001##k of #m100010000#, who seems to have some new information to share.
QuestInfo.1: #p1103001# claims that black shadows have been spotted all around #b#m100020000##k. He has asked you to investigate the forest of The Hill North of Henesys. To get there, #bsearch the area with your mouse cursor, until you find something you can click on, and click it#k.
QuestInfo.2: You spotted a suspicious black shadow hidden in the forest, and you reported it to #p1103001#.

0.0: I just received big news! I can't disclose her name, but a girl in #m100010000# allegedly found a group of suspicious shadows moving in #b#m100010000##k. Doesn't that sound weird? I think we should look into it!

yes.0: I want you to go to #m100010000# and search the grassy areas, especially the ones in between the weeds and thickets. If you can find anything, anything at all, let me know, okay?
yes.1: Just in case you are not sure how to search for things... #buse your cursor to roam around the screen until you find something you can click on. When you spot something, you can click on it immediately#k.

no.0: Eh? Doesn't it sound suspicious enough? Other than that, I haven't received much information on Black Mage...

1.0: So you spotted a black shadow in between the forest? Ahh... it would have been nice if we could have captured him. But if it is indeed one of Black Mage's men, then there's no way he would have been caught that easily.

yes.0: Thank you so much for your help! I'll be here to check on them continually, so I want you to keep training until the next big mission comes up, okay?
